visual_goal: Show own assistants entering through the AI platform and third-party agents through the agent gateway, both reaching the domain contracts only via a tool registry governed by the AI register.
prompt: A top-down layered illustration. Top row: on the left a chat-bubble app icon labeled 'Own assistants', on the right a generic robot-arm icon outside a doorway labeled 'Third-party agents'. Second row: on the left a teal panel with a small eye icon labeled 'AI platform', on the right a gate with an identity-badge icon labeled 'Agent gateway'. One arrow from 'Own assistants' down into 'AI platform', and one arrow from 'Third-party agents' down into 'Agent gateway'. Third row, centered: a cabinet of neatly labeled drawers labeled 'Tool registry', receiving one arrow from 'AI platform' and one arrow from 'Agent gateway'. Bottom row: one wide solid blue foundation slab labeled 'Domain contracts', with one arrow from 'Tool registry' down into it. At the right side of the third row, a small ledger book labeled 'AI register' with one dashed arrow into 'Tool registry'. Exactly six arrows.
alt: Own assistants pass through the AI platform and third-party agents through the agent gateway; both reach a tool registry, governed by the AI register, which is the only path to the domain contracts.

visual_goal: Show the redesigned agentic booking: ambiguity goes back to the traveler, the price is a binding quote with a platform-written summary, and the traveler confirms before the booking is created.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with four widely spaced vertical lanes, each headed by a simple icon and label: 'Traveler' (generic person with a phone), 'AI agent' (small robot head), 'Gateway' (gate icon), 'Reservations' (ledger book). Every arrow starts exactly on its source lane line and ends exactly on its target lane line. Horizontal arrows top to bottom in time order: from 'AI agent' to 'Gateway' labeled 'Search Porto'; a dashed arrow from 'Gateway' back to 'AI agent' labeled 'ambiguous'; from 'AI agent' to 'Traveler' labeled 'Which Porto?'; from 'Traveler' to 'AI agent' labeled 'Portugal'; a dashed arrow from 'Gateway' to 'AI agent' labeled 'binding quote'; from 'AI agent' to 'Traveler' labeled 'summary'; from 'Traveler' across to 'Gateway' labeled 'confirm'; from 'Gateway' to 'Reservations' labeled 'book'. Eight arrows in total.
alt: Swimlanes for traveler, AI agent, gateway and reservations: an ambiguous Porto search goes back to the traveler, who chooses Portugal; a binding quote and summary are shown, the traveler confirms, and the gateway books.

visual_goal: Show every AI use registered, its consequence class choosing the controls, all going live with traces, and claim errors or incidents returning to the register.
prompt: A left-to-right loop illustration. At the far left a small lightbulb labeled 'New AI use'. One arrow to an open ledger book labeled 'Register'. One arrow from the book to an orange diamond labeled 'Consequence class'. From the diamond three arrows fan out to three stacked rounded boxes: the top green box labeled 'Light review', the middle teal box labeled 'Limits and authority', the bottom blue box labeled 'Human review'. One arrow from each of the three boxes converges into a box on the far right with a small heartbeat-trace icon labeled 'Live'. A long curved orange arrow runs along the bottom from 'Live' back to 'Register', labeled 'claim errors'. Exactly nine arrows.
alt: A new AI use is registered, its consequence class routes it to light review, limits and authority, or human review, it goes live with traces, and claim errors loop back to the register.
